Metadata.Frequency: Data is updated on 10th of each month or as available.

columns.name: DATE OF GOODS RECEIVED
columns.description: Date associated with the confirmed delivery of goods or services as specified in the vendor, invoice details.

columns.name: FUND (GROUPED)
columns.description: Fund (Grouped) is an field exclusive to this dataset and related dashboards to improve ease of use  for audience.  This field is not an official data point or record in the City's financial management system (FMPS).  The groupings are subject to change.

columns.name: FUND (CODE)
columns.description: Code associated with the Fund.  Designated with the Budget Ordinance and aligns with City financial management systems.

columns.name: FUND (DESCRIPTION)
columns.description: Also known as Fund Name.  Description of the Fund.  Designated with the Budget Ordinance and aligns with City financial management systems.

columns.name: FUND TYPE (DESCRIPTION)
columns.description: Funding Type.  Designated with the Budget Ordinance.  (e.g. Grant Funds, compared to Corporate Fund)

columns.name: INVOICE (CODE)
columns.description: Also known as Invoice Number.  This code acts as an identifier for an associated invoice. Aligns with City financial management systems.

columns.name: INVOICE (DESCRIPTION)
columns.description: This is the description associated with the particular invoice.  Aligns with City financial management systems.

columns.name: VENDOR (CODE)
columns.description: Also known as Vendor ID. This code acts as an identifier for an associated Vendor. Aligns with City financial management systems.

columns.name: VENDOR (DESCRIPTION)
columns.description: Also known as Vendor Name.  This is the description associated with the particular Vendor Code.  Aligns with City financial management systems.
